title: rev-revit writer coverage matrix (CRUD x element category)
description: Battle-hardening as a measured number. Each cell of {category} x {verb} carries its implementing function, its proof generator (a make_*.py driver the runner reruns), its proof file(s), and — for READ — a probe against a real corpus file. tools/coverage.py fills each cell's `result` (validates / error_count / viewer_certified / last_run) and the top-level `summary`; everything else is the hand-authored definition. Certification comes from docs/coverage/viewer-certified.json (orchestrator-maintained ledger of files Autodesk's own reader accepted).
